title: Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence for Education
summary: The Union Budget 2025-26 announced a Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence for Education with an allocation of ₹500 crore, the fourth national AI centre of excellence after those for healthcare, agriculture and sustainable cities. According to a Ministry of Education reply in the Lok Sabha on 20 July 2026, the centre has been set up at IIT Madras for the period 2025-26 to 2029-30. It is meant to develop AI tools for education, such as personalised learning and assessment, in line with the National Education Policy 2020.
